title: Kadane's Algorithm
tagline: The maximum-subarray classic — one pass, one decision: extend or restart.

intuition.analogy: Walking a trail tracking elevation gain, at each step you ask: 'is my journey so far helping me, or is it dead weight?' If your accumulated gain went negative, you mentally restart the count from here — carrying a deficit forward never helps a future stretch.
paragraphs: The maximum subarray problem asks for the contiguous slice with the largest sum. Brute force checks all O(n²) subarrays. Kadane realises a beautiful fact: the best subarray ending at position i is either just a[i], or a[i] appended to the best subarray ending at i-1 — whichever is larger.

So you keep one running value cur = best sum of a subarray ending here. At each element you either extend the previous run (cur + a[i]) or start fresh (a[i]). You also keep best = the maximum cur seen so far.

The 'restart' happens exactly when the running sum has gone negative — because a negative prefix can only hurt whatever comes next. This single insight collapses a quadratic search into a linear scan.
intuition.keyIdea: Best subarray ending at i = max(a[i], cur + a[i]). Track the global best as you go.

steps.title: Initialise
steps.detail: cur = best = a[0]. cur is the best sum of a subarray that ends at the current index.

steps.title: Extend or restart
steps.detail: For each next element: cur = max(a[i], cur + a[i]). If cur + a[i] < a[i], the old run was net-negative, so we abandon it.

steps.title: Track the global maximum
steps.detail: best = max(best, cur) after every step.

complexity.timeReason: A single pass with O(1) work per element.
complexity.spaceReason: Two scalars (cur, best). Tracking indices adds a couple more.

pitfalls: All-negative arrays: initialise with a[0], not 0, or you'll wrongly return 0.
To recover the actual subarray, record the start index whenever you restart and the end when best updates.
The 2D version (max sum rectangle) fixes a column band then runs Kadane on row sums.

dryRun.clickMoment: At i=3, the running sum was negative, so cur restarts at 4 and discards the bad prefix. From there the run [4,-1,2,1] accumulates to 6 — the answer. The restart decision is the whole algorithm.

problems.title: Maximum Subarray
problems.statement: Find the contiguous subarray with the largest sum.
problems.hint: Direct Kadane; initialise with the first element.

problems.title: Maximum Product Subarray
problems.statement: Find the contiguous subarray with the largest product.
problems.hint: Track both max and min running products — a negative can flip min into max.

problems.title: Maximum Sum Circular Subarray
problems.statement: Max subarray sum where the array is circular.
problems.hint: Answer = max(normal Kadane, total − minimum subarray). Handle the all-negative edge case.

problems.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
problems.statement: Maximise profit from one buy and one sell.
problems.hint: Kadane on consecutive differences, or track the running minimum price.

problems.title: Maximum Sum Rectangle (2D)
problems.statement: Find the maximum-sum submatrix in a 2D grid.
problems.hint: Fix a pair of columns, compress rows to sums, run Kadane over rows.
